# ADAM v0.50 Architecture

```text
                           ADAM COGNITION FABRIC
          perception ─ graph learning ─ causal dynamics ─ planning
                                  │ proposes
                                  ▼
                        SHADOW-UNIVERSE LABORATORY
                                  │ proofs / uncertainty
                                  ▼
                  GOVERNANCE + CONSTITUTIONAL PHYSICS
       valence │ reaction VM │ conservation │ purpose │ independent approval
                                  │ quorum commit
                                  ▼
                    AUTHORITATIVE ATOMIC UNIVERSE
 atoms │ recursive bonds │ hyperbonds │ compounds │ worldlines │ chemistry
                                  │
             ┌────────────────────┼────────────────────┐
             ▼                    ▼                    ▼
     APPLICATION ORGANS      EMBODIED ORGANS      RECREATION FABRIC
   APIs/docs/SQL/events     sensors/digital twins   files/media/programs
             │                    │                    │
             └────────────────────┼────────────────────┘
                                  ▼
                 SOVEREIGN DISTRIBUTED AUTHORITY
 encryption │ closure auth │ jurisdiction │ witnesses │ erasure │ failover
```

## State transition rule

A cognitive organ may propose a reaction. A shadow universe may simulate it. Laws, authority, valence, evidence and security must validate it. A majority-certified authority commit is the only official mechanism that advances accepted reality.

## Exact and semantic duality

Exact evidence and reconstruction recipes remain independently verifiable. Semantic interpretations may evolve through new chemistry, but they cannot rewrite exact evidence. Unknown finite byte sequences remain exactly recreatable through the inherited v0.42 fallback even when no semantic organ understands them.

## Recursive relationship model

A bond is a first-class atomic structure and can participate as the source or target of another bond. Hyperbonds preserve events involving multiple roles without reducing them to disconnected triples. Compounds, bonds, events, models, goals and concepts can all become higher-order atoms.

## Self-evolution

Chemistry proposals are generated in discovery mode, replayed against historical evidence, checked for exact reconstruction, query/security/authority equivalence and cost, and require independent approval. The proposer cannot approve its own chemistry. Every promoted version remains rollback-addressable.
